# Pull request

## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and associated issue. Use `Closes #…` only when the complete issue is resolved.

## Validation

Record executed checks, results and relevant limitations. Summarize the completed independent code review without tool attribution or local evidence links.

## Installed-user impact

Replace the synthetic PR and issue numbers below with this PR and its associated issue. For user-visible changes, replace the no-effect record with the user-impact format in [Change-note tooling](https://github.com/ohtia/ohtia/blob/main/docs/change-notes.md#pr-capture). Keep exactly one `ohtia-note` block. Explain the actual effect; do not announce unfinished capabilities.

```ohtia-note
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "pr": 1,
  "issues": [1],
  "impact": "none",
  "reason": "Replace with the concrete reason this change has no effect on installed users."
}
```
